sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Eccleshall on Saturday at 15:00 in a third-versus-fourth clash. The Ramblers are on an impressive 5-game unbeaten run (most recently drawing) and will look to capitalize on their strong home form, while Eccleshall arrive as dangerous visitors on the back of a 4-game winning streak. This should be a competitive encounter between two of the division's in-form sides.
divisionWide: AFC Bridgnorth, currently top with 19 points from 7 games and on a 5-game winning streak, travel to Brereton Social, who have been struggling with just 2 wins from 7 games. Stafford Town (second place, 19 points) face a tricky away trip to Cheadle Heath Nomads, who are winless in their last 5 games. In the title race, all three of the leading trio (Bridgnorth, Stafford Town, and Sandbach) are in action simultaneously on Saturday. Foley Meir (11 points) host bottom-side Widnes Town (2 points) in what should be a comfortable fixture for the hosts. New Mills entertain Dawley Town in a mid-table encounter, Crewe welcome struggling Wednesfield Community, Allscott Heath face Alsager Town (the division's second-lowest scorers with 4 points), Shawbury United host Wolverhampton Casuals, Bilston Town visit Market Drayton Town, and Telford Town travel to Barnton. The bottom end of the table features several teams desperate for points, particularly Widnes Town and Alsager Town.
